name: WarTable: Democracy is Optional
detailed_description:
🎮 WarTable: Democracy Is Optional

Brief Description: WarTable is a real-time strategy sandbox where teams of up to nine players take command of a host nation. Build your military, shape your government, forge alliances—or betray them. In WarTable, strategy is everything, and democracy is just one of many options.

🛠️ Steam Page Draft

Title: WarTable

Tagline: Democracy Is Optional.

About This Game

Lead a nation. Build an empire. Or watch it fall.

WarTable is a real-time strategy game like no other. Designed for immersive, team-based gameplay, each match pits multiple player-run nations against one another in a living, breathing sandbox of diplomacy, warfare, and deception.

Up to 9 players per team take on critical roles in their “Host Country,” managing the military, economy, home development, defense, intelligence, and more. Appoint leaders—or overthrow them. Create laws—or break them. The rules of engagement are up to you.

Whether you want to lead an honorable republic, a powerful military regime, or a backstabbing rogue state, WarTable gives you the tools to do it.

🧠 Key Features

  • Team-Based Command: Up to 9 players per nation, each managing different aspects of governance and warfare.

  • Dynamic Governments: Elect leaders, pass laws, or stage coups. Every team creates its own political structure.

  • Warfare Across Land, Sea & Air: Take charge of your military assets and outmaneuver enemy nations in full-scale warfare.

  • Homefront Management: Balance economic growth, civil stability, and internal defense as you expand your influence.

  • Sandbox Freedom: Form alliances. Trade resources. Spy. Sabotage. Or just go full dictator—your nation, your rules.

  • Live Diplomacy: Real-time decisions, alliances, betrayals, and negotiations with other nations add depth and chaos to every game.

🧨 Will You Lead with Honor? Or Rule with Fear?

The world is yours to build—or burn.
Gather your team. Take your seat at the WarTable.
